verified_apis.input: The local request control is sent over a loopback TCP byte stream to the Node HTTP server.

no_api_findings.finding: The Request and Response constructors create API objects from structured inputs; they do not expose a JavaScript API that parses a supplied raw HTTP/1.1 wire message. Browser network stacks parse HTTP internally, but no local byte-input parser is in this scoped API inventory.

limit: The browser finding covers the standardized Fetch API, not every private browser or JavaScript host API.
